content:
The **Helvetia Hotel** is a building within the Appalachian town of Helvetia.

Located on Pickens Road, at the western end of the bridge in the center of town, it is a two-story tall building. The first floor has the lobby, with the reception counter, a small sitting area and a Pool Table. On the eastern site is a small kitchen, with the nearby stairs leading to the second floor.

The second floor has a total of three bedrooms. The eastern room has a Duffle Bag and a Tool Case. To the west are another small sitting area and two more bedrooms, with the northeastern one having another Duffle Bag and an Ammo Box, while the northwestern one has Picklock skill 1-locked Footlocker and a note.

The Helvetia Hotel appears in *Fallout 76*.
